mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(ci.coupon_count, 0) AS totalCouponCount, COALESCE(bul.redeem_count, 0) AS totalRedeemCount, COALESCE(bul.redeem_amount, 0) AS totalRedeemAmount, COALESCE(co.refund_count, 0) AS totalRefundCount, COALESCE(co.refund_amount, 0) AS totalRefundAmount, COALESCE(rr.risk_count, 0) AS totalRiskCount, COALESCE(ab.used_budget, 0) AS totalBudgetUsed, COALESCE(ab.total_budget, 0) - COALESCE(ab.used_budget, 0) AS totalBudgetRemain, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ab.total_budget, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(ab.used_budget, 0) / ab.total_budget * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS budgetUsageRate, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ci.coupon_count, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(bul.redeem_count, 0) / ci.coupon_count * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS redeemRate, CASE WHEN COALESCE(bul.redeem_count, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(co.refund_count, 0) / bul.redeem_count * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS refundRate FROM (SELECT 1 AS dummy) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS coupon_count FROM t_coupon_instance WHERE receive_time >= #{startDate} AND receive_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND is_deleted = 0 ) ci ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS redeem_count, COALESCE(SUM(benefit_value), 0) AS redeem_amount FROM t_benefit_use_log WHERE use_status = 2 AND confirm_time >= #{startDate} AND confirm_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND is_deleted = 0 ) bul ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS refund_count, COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount FROM t_consume_order WHERE order_status = 5 AND refund_time >= #{startDate} AND refund_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND is_deleted = 0 ) co ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS risk_count FROM t_risk_record WHERE handle_result = 3 AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND is_deleted = 0 ) rr ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_budget), 0) AS total_budget, COALESCE(SUM(used_budget), 0) AS used_budget FROM t_activity_budget WHERE store_code IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0 ) ab ON 1=1

SELECT d.stat_date AS statDate, COALESCE(ci.coupon_count, 0) AS couponCount, COALESCE(bul.redeem_count, 0) AS redeemCount, COALESCE(bul.redeem_amount, 0) AS redeemAmount, COALESCE(co.refund_count, 0) AS refundCount, COALESCE(co.refund_amount, 0) AS refundAmount, COALESCE(rr.risk_count, 0) AS riskCount, COALESCE(abl.budget_used, 0) AS budgetUsed FROM ( SELECT DATE(#{startDate}) + INTERVAL (t.n) DAY AS stat_date FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23 UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL SELECT 25 UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27 UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29 UNION ALL SELECT 30 UNION ALL SELECT 31 ) t WHERE DATE(#{startDate}) + INTERVAL t.n DAY <= #{endDate} ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(receive_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS coupon_count FROM t_coupon_instance WHERE receive_time >= #{startDate} AND receive_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(receive_time) ) ci ON d.stat_date = ci.stat_date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(confirm_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS redeem_count, COALESCE(SUM(benefit_value), 0) AS redeem_amount FROM t_benefit_use_log WHERE use_status = 2 AND confirm_time >= #{startDate} AND confirm_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(confirm_time) ) bul ON d.stat_date = bul.stat_date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(refund_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS refund_count, COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount FROM t_consume_order WHERE order_status = 5 AND refund_time >= #{startDate} AND refund_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(refund_time) ) co ON d.stat_date = co.stat_date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS risk_count FROM t_risk_record WHERE handle_result = 3 AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) rr ON d.stat_date = rr.stat_date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS stat_date, COALESCE(SUM(change_amount), 0) AS budget_used FROM t_activity_budget_log WHERE change_type IN (1, 2, 3) AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) abl ON d.stat_date = abl.stat_date ORDER BY d.stat_date

SELECT s.store_code AS storeCode, s.store_name AS storeName, s.city, COALESCE(bul.redeem_count, 0) AS redeemCount, COALESCE(co.refund_count, 0) AS refundCount, COALESCE(rr.risk_count, 0) AS riskCount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ci.coupon_count, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(bul.redeem_count, 0) / ci.coupon_count * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS redeemRate, COALESCE(ab.budget_usage_rate, 0) AS budgetUsageRate FROM t_store_info s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT store_code, COUNT(*) AS coupon_count FROM t_coupon_instance WHERE DATE(receive_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND is_deleted = 0 AND store_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_code ) ci ON s.store_code = ci.store_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT store_code, COUNT(*) AS redeem_count FROM t_benefit_use_log WHERE use_status = 2 AND DATE(confirm_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND is_deleted = 0 AND store_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_code ) bul ON s.store_code = bul.store_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT store_code, COUNT(*) AS refund_count FROM t_consume_order WHERE order_status = 5 AND DATE(refund_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND is_deleted = 0 AND store_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_code ) co ON s.store_code = co.store_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT store_code, COUNT(*) AS risk_count FROM t_risk_record WHERE handle_result = 3 AND DATE(create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND is_deleted = 0 AND store_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_code ) rr ON s.store_code = rr.store_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ab.store_code, CASE WHEN SUM(ab.total_budget) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(ab.used_budget) / SUM(ab.total_budget) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS budget_usage_rate FROM t_activity_budget ab WHERE ab.store_code IS NOT NULL AND ab.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ab.store_code ) ab ON s.store_code = ab.store_code WHERE s.status = 1 AND s.is_deleted = 0

SELECT s.store_code AS storeCode, s.store_name AS storeName, s.city, COALESCE(bul.redeem_count, 0) AS redeemCount, COALESCE(co.refund_count, 0) AS refundCount, COALESCE(rr.risk_count, 0) AS riskCount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ci.coupon_count, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(bul.redeem_count, 0) / ci.coupon_count * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS redeemRate, COALESCE(ab.budget_usage_rate, 0) AS budgetUsageRate FROM t_store_info s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT store_code, COUNT(*) AS coupon_count FROM t_coupon_instance WHERE DATE(receive_time) = CURDATE() AND is_deleted = 0 AND store_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_code ) ci ON s.store_code = ci.store_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT store_code, COUNT(*) AS redeem_count FROM t_benefit_use_log WHERE use_status = 2 AND DATE(confirm_time) = CURDATE() AND is_deleted = 0 AND store_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_code ) bul ON s.store_code = bul.store_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT store_code, COUNT(*) AS refund_count FROM t_consume_order WHERE order_status = 5 AND DATE(refund_time) = CURDATE() AND is_deleted = 0 AND store_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_code ) co ON s.store_code = co.store_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT store_code, COUNT(*) AS risk_count FROM t_risk_record WHERE handle_result = 3 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND is_deleted = 0 AND store_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_code ) rr ON s.store_code = rr.store_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ab.store_code, CASE WHEN SUM(ab.total_budget) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(ab.used_budget) / SUM(ab.total_budget) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS budget_usage_rate FROM t_activity_budget ab WHERE ab.store_code IS NOT NULL AND ab.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ab.store_code ) ab ON s.store_code = ab.store_code WHERE s.status = 1 AND s.is_deleted = 0
